headline: 3 stories worth your time — mostly rules & risk. Start with: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation

items.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
items.summary: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Note the compliance date and check whether your business size is in scope.

items.title: Verizon Invests $70M to Provide Free AI Training for American Workforce
items.summary: Verizon commits $70 million to enhance the American workforce by offering free AI training programs. Discover how this initiative aims to equip workers with essential skills for the future and foster innovation across industries.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Check whether the free tier covers your actual volume before paying for the equivalent elsewhere.

items.title: Prompt: AI agents are running into the limits of access
items.summary: As agents take on more work for users, companies are deciding whether to let outside AI systems act on their platforms.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Skim it, then decide in one minute whether it changes anything you do this week.
